conventions.extends: characters.player_b EXTENDS characters.player (assets/characters): merge its anims into the player definition (each anim names its own atlas `char_player_b`); every other field of the player (carryPoint, petPoint, shadow, portrait, the old anims) stays as it is.  Stand-alone it is also a complete character def (frameSize, anchor, dirs, mirror, frameName).
conventions.rig: Rendered with the player rig itself (char_build.build("player"): white fur parka, brown belt + satchel, boots, hair), bl_common camera / light / PPU 64, char_render scene settings and the char_pack 1 px ink outline: same scale, look and outline as char_player.  char_player is not touched.
conventions.frames: 128 x 128, anchor [0.5, 0.8125] = px (64, 104); names {anim}_{dir}_{i}; rendered dirs S, SE, E (anims[*].dirs), mirrors SW <- SE, W <- E with flipX (negate dx of every point).  NE / N do not exist: the game turns him to the nearest rendered dir.
conventions.standing: talk, wave, warm_hands, cheer: anchor = the ground under his feet (as player); headTop -81.
conventions.seated: sit_idle, sit_write, sit_read, sit_eat, doze (anims[*].seated): anchor = the SEAT POINT = the seat surface front-centre of a 0.45 m chair (townfolk2 sit / officefolk / office chiefDeskPoint / life2 seatPoints convention); place the sprite AT the seat point (it already includes the seat height).  No chair or desk is drawn.  The desk / table top is 0.72 m from the floor, its near edge 0.10 m in front of the seat front: mittens, quill, stamp, bowl and paper work at that height.  seat.floorBelowPx = the floor is that many px below the seat point (outside the frame on purpose: draw his shadow there), seat.deskEdgePoint = the desk-top near-edge centre per dir.  Chibi legs hang toward the floor (they cannot reach 0.45 m down, like every seated townsperson); a desk / table front drawn over him hides them.  headTopSit = the seated head top (speech bubbles, emote_zzz).
conventions.points: every *Point value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the anchor (unscaled), per rendered dir.  anims.sit_write.impactPoint = the stamp face on the desk at impactFrame 4 (spawn the stamp puff + sfx_stamp there).
conventions.loopFrom: anims.sit_read.loopFrom 2: frames 0-1 (folded paper lifted and shaken open) play ONCE, then 2-5 (reading) loop.  Never loop sit_read 0-5 plainly: the paper would snap shut every second.  Zero-code way: play `sit_read_in` (repeat 0) and on complete `sit_read_loop` (or just `sit_read_loop`) - two ALIAS anims (anims[*].aliasOf) whose frame names point at the same atlas rectangles as sit_read 0-1 / 2-5 (and their _desk overlays), so the stock Assets.buildCharacter builds them like any anim.
conventions.pacing: optional hints (ms) for a calmer loop: anims.cheer.repeatDelay 600 = Phaser anim config repeatDelay (the pennant-up last frame holds between hops, one hop per 1.2 s instead of 100 a minute); anims.doze.frameHold {"2": 1600} = Phaser frame `duration` on frame 2 (the deepest nod lingers, a nod every ~2.9 s).  Without them the anims still play per contract.
conventions.headTop: headTop -81 (= player) for every standing anim, except where anims[x].headTop says the head rises higher (talk nods, the wave lean, the cheer hop): use the anim value for bubbles / the star pin while it plays.  anims.cheer.propTop = the pennant top (it flies beside the head, out to his right / ahead).  headTopSit for every seated anim.
conventions.faces: faces are part of the frames: blink (sit_idle 2, talk 4, sit_read 4, warm_hands 3), sleeping eyes (doze), happy squint (sit_eat 3, wave, cheer), open / half-open mouth (talk, cheer).
conventions.props: props are part of the frames (no extra sprites): teal quill + wooden stamp with a red face (sit_write), newspaper cream with grey columns, masthead band and a photo box - no text (sit_read), red soup bowl + wooden spoon (sit_eat), a little teal 서리마을 pennant with a cream snowflake on a birch stick (cheer: held up in the right fist, the flag flies out above his shoulder line - beside the head in S / SE / SW, ahead of him in E / W).  Nothing is carried on the head.
conventions.office: office routine: desk anims at chiefDeskPoint facing chiefDeskDir (SW), band behind, `_desk` overlay over chief_office_interior_front.  The 22:00 "doze by the stove": warm_hands standing at stovePoint (facing the stove), then doze on the desk chair (chiefDeskPoint) - stovePoint has no seat.

deskOverlay.zone: surface points in front of the desk near edge (y < -0.10 m) and 0.002-0.31 m above the desk top: forearms, mittens, quill, stamp, paper, bowl, spoon
deskOverlay.depthHint: draw `{anim}_{dir}_{i}_desk` at the chief's position right ABOVE the desk / table art (office: depthOffset -0.095, just over chief_office_interior_front -0.10), same frame index, same flipX; the full frame stays in @behind.

doze.placeAt: a SEAT point only (office chiefDeskPoint = the desk chair, bench / log seatPoints); never office stovePoint (a standing ground point with no seat: he would float)
